name: Stalder Press
steps: Sit in a wide straddle, lean forward and plant your hands shoulder-width apart just in front of your hips.
Press down with straight arms and lean over your wrists until your hips and heels lift together.
Continue pushing tall through your straight arms as your hips stack steadily over your shoulders and your legs sweep wide and upward.
Bring your legs cleanly together overhead into a straight handstand, then lower back down smoothly through the straddle with control.
tips: Keep your elbows locked completely straight and actively compress your hips toward your torso throughout the lift.
Develop solid active pancake flexibility and handstand balance before attempting the full press.
